note: OpenAPI enums: concrete generic enums (ApiResponse<Vec<User>>) are inlined with their type arguments substituted like generic structs; serde_repr enums (Serialize_repr / Deserialize_repr) document {type: integer, enum: [discriminants]} per side; enum request views ({Name}Input) follow the deserialize side (sided rename / rename_all / rename_all_fields, skip_serializing vs skip_deserializing variants, struct-variant field defaults)
